columns.name: berth
columns.reason: Berth allocation comes from the vessel berthing plan and is not derived from the container's condition.

columns.name: paint_spec
columns.reason: Coating specification is fixed when the container is built.

columns.name: iso_type_code
columns.reason: Static ISO equipment type code carried on the unit.

columns.name: chassis_type
columns.reason: Chassis is chosen as part of haulage planning, before arrival assessment.

columns.name: repair_shop
columns.reason: A repair shop is only assigned once damage has been found and booked for repair.

columns.name: reefer_flag
columns.reason: Whether the unit is refrigerated is a permanent equipment attribute.

columns.name: haulier
columns.reason: The trucking company is contracted at booking/dispatch time.

columns.name: stack_position
columns.reason: Slot in the stow/yard stack is fixed by the stowage plan at loading.

columns.name: depot_code
columns.reason: Depot assignment is part of the movement plan, not of the damage finding.

columns.name: booking_office
columns.reason: Recorded when the booking is created, well before arrival.

columns.name: recert_month
columns.reason: CSC recertification date is a scheduled attribute of the unit known in advance.

columns.name: voyage_legs
columns.reason: The routing/itinerary is set at booking, though a count of actually sailed legs would only close on arrival.

columns.name: weighbridge_id
columns.reason: Weighing for VGM happens at origin gate-in, before the voyage.

columns.name: offhire_days
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether this is prior idle time for the unit or off-hire time caused by this damage and repair.

columns.name: port_pair
columns.reason: Origin/destination pair is fixed at booking.

columns.name: lessor
columns.reason: Ownership/lease party is known for the unit before the move.

columns.name: prior_damage_history_index
columns.reason: Explicitly prior history, summarising events before this movement.

columns.name: survey_structural_damage_code
columns.reason: Produced by the arrival survey that also determines the target.

columns.name: days_to_release
columns.reason: Only measurable once the container has actually been released after arrival.

columns.name: seal_type
columns.reason: Seal is applied at stuffing/origin and recorded on the shipping documents.

columns.name: ocr_camera_set
columns.reason: Identifies fixed gate capture hardware, an infrastructure attribute rather than a survey result.

columns.name: manufacture_yard
columns.reason: Build location is permanent unit provenance.

columns.name: gate_lane
columns.reason: Gate lane is a handling/infrastructure identifier recorded at interchange, not derived from damage assessment.

columns.name: customs_regime
columns.reason: Declared on the customs documentation before arrival.

columns.name: crane_id
columns.reason: Handling equipment identifier from the discharge operation, which precedes the condition survey.

columns.name: imo_class
columns.reason: Dangerous-goods class is declared at booking.

columns.name: trade_lane
columns.reason: Commercial lane is known as soon as the routing is set.

columns.name: lashing_spec
columns.reason: Lashing/securing specification is set by the stowage plan at load.

columns.name: photo_batch
columns.reason: Could be an automated gate photo set available at interchange or the damage survey photo set created with the label.

columns.name: survey_watertight_fail_code
columns.reason: A survey outcome code generated by the same arrival inspection as the target.

columns.name: cargo_weight_t
columns.reason: Verified gross mass is declared and final before loading.

columns.name: inspection_shift
columns.reason: Exists only as part of the arrival inspection record that produces the outcome.

columns.name: depot_resurvey_grade
columns.reason: A resurvey grade is assigned after the container has been received and re-examined.

columns.name: repair_estimate_usd
columns.reason: A repair cost estimate can only be raised once damage has been identified.

columns.name: container_age_years
columns.reason: Derived from the build date, known at any point before arrival.

columns.name: vessel_class
columns.reason: Attribute of the carrying vessel, known once the ship is assigned.

columns.name: surveyor_firm
columns.reason: Recorded as part of the arrival survey that establishes the damage status.

columns.name: terminal
columns.reason: Discharge terminal is part of the routing known before arrival.

columns.name: service_string
columns.reason: The liner service loop is fixed when the booking is routed.

columns.name: cscs_plate_class
columns.reason: CSC safety approval plate class is a static certification attribute of the unit.

columns.name: owner_prefix
columns.reason: The BIC owner prefix is part of the permanent container identity.
